notes.title: Version 0.9.4r1: Whale Scene Update, Bug fixes. New instagram page!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[list]

Best wishes,
The ECS Team

notes.title: Version 0.9.3r1: Polish language added, QOL fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

[b]We're proud to announce that Polish language has been added to the game![/b]
W razie literówek lub problemów z formatowaniem tekstu, proszę dajcie znać na naszym serwerze Discord :)

After attending the Sofia Game Jam in April, we've gathered some of your feedback and fixed some of the stuff you mentioned to us.

- Camera shake when running is now adjustable
- Loading screens shortened
- FOV adjustment now properly interacts with screens in game
- Central dot (crosshair) now disappears when the game takes control over the player
- Tooltip added to the 'Extra Pixelated' setting*

*The purpose of the setting was not exactly clear when we implemented it, as it makes a difference only on bigger screens. We added that as a tooltip in the Settings!

It's been a long few months for us, since we're cooking something in the meantime. Check our Instagram for the latest updates!
https://www.instagram.com/extracosmic.studios/

Thank you for your support as a community. It really means the world to us, and we can't be thankful enough for your engagement in our work. Stay tuned to the updates!

Much love,
ECS Team

notes.title: Fear the Void | Outstanding Story-rich Game | Steam Awards
notes.content:
Attention Fear the Void followers!

We're thrilled to announce that Fear the Void has the chance to be recognized as an "Outstanding Story-rich Game" in The Steam Awards, and we NEED YOUR HELP! 🏆✨

Your passion for the game has not gone unnoticed and now is the time to show the world just how captivating Fear the Void's narrative truly is. 🌌✒️

Why nominate Fear the Void?

- Immerse yourself in a chilling atmosphere and mind-bending cosmic themes.
- Engage in a puzzle-solving adventure with survival sections that challenge your problem-solving and tactical skills.
- Make choices that influence the storyline, unlocking different endings, areas, and equipment for a truly [b]unique [/b]gaming experience.
- Enjoy a replayable journey, discovering new monsters, lore, and collectibles with each playthrough.

🚀How can you help?

☝️ [b]Just click the checkbox on the top of the announcement to nominate Fear the Void[/b], and we'll be more than thankful for your support 🙏

💬 Spread the word to your fellow horror enthusiasts, and cosmic explorers!

Your support means the world to us, and together, we can make Fear the Void the standout narrative experience of the year! 🙌

And as always...
Stay ExtraCosmic 👁️
